title: CQRV certificate envelope, schema v1.7.0
description: Report §8.4.2, §8.4.4, §9.5.1, §9.5.3; DECISIONS.md 2026-10-24 (Stage 8a, reviewer decision 3). Written by CQRV.Certify.Certificate.toJson. v1.1.0 (DECISIONS.md 2026-10-25, Stage 8b) adds theorem, obligations and the machine fields of reference_configuration; v1.2.0 (Stage 8b review) adds trust_boundary.front_end; v1.3.0 (DECISIONS.md 2026-10-25, Stage 9b decision 1) lets front_end be the exhaustive-validation wording (n ≤ 16) or the Stage 8b wording (n > 16); v1.4.0 (DECISIONS.md 2026-10-26, Stage 11b decision 5) adds the optional object hardware (`cqr certify --profile`): a certificate without it is unchanged and keeps schema_version "1.3.0" (valid under v1.4.0), one with it says "1.4.0" (hardware present iff schema_version is "1.4.0"); v1.5.0 (DECISIONS.md 2026-10-26, Stage 12d decision 5) adds the optional field diffusion_shape (omitted means "tree"): only a certificate of `cqr certify --shape few:log` carries it and says "1.5.0" (diffusion_shape present iff schema_version is "1.5.0"; hardware optional there), so the tree certificates are unchanged; v1.6.0 (DECISIONS.md 2026-10-29, Stage 14a) adds the required object solution_count {value, status}: status "kernel_decided" when Cert.lean proves hM_count (Network.countSat_eq_card and decide +kernel; `cqr certify --count-limit k`, n ≤ k, default 12) and `cert` takes no hypothesis — the status line is then `certified` —, "hypothesis" when `cert` keeps hM_card (status line `certified (conditional on: solution_count = M)`); value = instance.M; every certificate written since Stage 14a says "1.6.0" (hardware and diffusion_shape optional under it; solution_count present iff schema_version is "1.6.0"). v1.7.0 (DECISIONS.md 2026-10-30, Stage 15b; PHASE2_SPEC.md §A.0.1) adds the optional field uncompute ("coherent": every temporary AND is undone by the adjoint of its compute block, no measurement, no classical bit; `cqr certify --uncompute coherent`, certified by grover_certificate_coherent): only such a certificate carries it and says "1.7.0" (uncompute present iff schema_version is "1.7.0"; solution_count required there too; omitted means "mbu"), so every MBU certificate keeps "1.6.0" byte for byte. Hardware fitness is not part of status. "not yet audited" (no kernel check): proof, cpu, theorem, kernel_check null, axioms and obligations empty. "certified": kernel check passed and the axiom audit passed (sorry-free, standard axioms or the trust-boundary table), no obligations. "certificate with tracked obligations": kernel check passed, audit failed; obligations names each one.

rational.description: An exact non-negative rational as Lean's `toString` of `Rat`: "0", "7", "7/128" (lowest terms, positive denominator > 1).

component.description: Report §3.3.2, Table 3.5: one component of the budget check; budget null = not limiting (not compared, fits true).

uncompute.description: PHASE2_SPEC.md §A.0.1 (Stage 15b): the uncomputation mode of the certified circuit when it is not the Phase 1 MBU (omitted means "mbu"): "coherent" = every temporary AND undone by the adjoint of its compute block (4 more T per AND, no measurement, no classical bit; `cqr certify --uncompute coherent`), certified by grover_certificate_coherent through grover_parametric_lemma_gen and Lemma 6.3.2 in mode coherent. The tool writes only "coherent"; "mbu" is accepted for hand-written envelopes.

solution_count.description: Report §8.2, §5.1.3 (Stage 14a): how the solution count M of the instance was obtained. kernel_decided: Cert.lean proves hM_count : (Finset.univ.filter …).card = M from Network.countSat_eq_card by decide +kernel (the kernel evaluates the network on all 2^n inputs) and theorem cert has no hypothesis; hypothesis: cert takes hM_card as a hypothesis (supplied, never decided; the only form before Stage 14a and the form for n > --count-limit). value equals instance.M (checked by tests/diff/certify_check.py).

diffusion_shape.description: Report §8.2, §8.4.1 (Stage 12d): the diffusion of the certified Grover circuit when it is not the V1 balanced tree (omitted means "tree"): "few:log" = the few-ancilla MCZ of Khattar–Gidney 2025 §5.3 with Maslov 2016 relative-phase Toffoli pairs (at most 2 clean ancillae), certified by grover_certificate_few_all (KG Theorem 5.1 for every n, Stage 13a; no per-instance classical check since Stage 13a′; Stage 12d certificates used grover_certificate_few with the classical KG step checked for their n).

hardware.description: Report §3.3.2–3.3.3, §5.3.1, §9.5.3 (Stage 11b): the measured grade against a declared hardware profile (profiles/<name>.json, docs/profile.schema.json) and the exact bound δ_hw = δ + G·p̄ (G = hardware_perturbation.G); vacuous when δ_hw ≥ 1; p_bar, delta_hw and vacuous null when the profile gives no p̄. profile_hash: SHA3-256 of the profile file with LF line endings. A check against declared figures, not a proof about hardware; not part of status. tests/diff/certify_check.py recomputes every field.

note.const: routing, native gates and calibration are outside the trust boundary

grade.description: Measured grade (w, d, t, a) of the emitted circuit (report §3.1.1).

hashes.description: SHA3-256, lower-case hex. predicate: DSL source with LF line endings; circuit: compact sorted-key IR JSON; proof: certificate .lean file with the pinned configuration (Stage 8b; null before).

anyOf.const: DSL → network (toNetwork) unverified; predicate_hash binds the source

anyOf.pattern: ^DSL → network: exhaustively validated \(2\^([0-9]|1[0-6]) inputs\) by the unverified evaluator; not kernel-checked$

hardware_perturbation.description: Report §3.3.3: δ_hw ≤ δ + G·p̄ (conservative: every noisy operation counts); G = unitary + mid_circuit_measurements + classically_controlled + terminal_measurements (alloc/free excluded; the sum is checked by tests/diff/cert_schema.py); p̄ is a parameter of the hardware profile.

kernel_check.description: Report §9.5.1: wall_ms = wall time of `lake env lean Cert.lean` (process start, imports, elaboration, kernel); kernel_ms = `type checking` of the Lean profiler; statistic says how runs were aggregated (scripts/bench_kernel.sh: median of 5, first run excluded). Timing fields: they differ between runs.
